approach: Static recompilation of the game's MIPS code to C, built into one universal executable that runs the region you mount.
help: Graphical boot/playthrough testing of the Japan/Asia (SLPS-01842) build
notes: Europe (SLES-01722) and USA (SCUS-94424) are supported; Japan/Asia (SLPS-01842) is included in the universal executable but still experimental. Windows builds use OpenGL by default, Linux also ships Vulkan.
